name: Mekgineer Thermaplugg's Walking Bombs spawn 20 yards away, not under him (#12029)
contract: Issue #12029: Thermaplugg's kit Walking Bombs (9780710) appeared under the boss. The kit summoned each one at
SMART_TARGET_RANDOM_POINT range 20, whose radius is uniform from 0 to 20 yards. The kit's in-game check places
them about 20 yards from him, so each Jackhammer (2102788, first cast 9.1-11.1 s into combat) now summons three
bombs on a 20-yard ring around him. Frostbite 12494 roots Thermaplugg so Knock Away cannot pull him off his spot.
The observer stands 3 yards from him and stays out of the fight; the nearest ring bomb is then at least 17 yards
from the observer. With the old uniform radius, the nearest of three bombs lands within 15 yards of the observer

steps.label: CONTROL: no Walking Bomb before the fight
CONTROL: Jackhammer summons three Walking Bombs
No Walking Bomb spawns at Thermaplugg's feet
